title: 第394章 两个母体第393章 侦查
slug: 满级师妹她缺德但能打
content_zh:
林青璇含在嘴里的那口粥还没咽下去，赵烈的靴子已经在忘忧峰的石板上印出了两个湿漉漉的泥脚印。他整个人瘫在石凳上，后背靠上石榴树粗糙的树干时长长地吐了一口气，像是把这一整夜憋在胸腔里的瘴气和紧张全吐了出来。那双被沼泽淤泥泡透的靴子每动一下就发出噗嗤噗嗤的挤压声，袜子和鞋垫吸饱了黑水沼泽的泥水，踩在石板上直打滑。他索性把靴子脱了搁在石凳底下，赤着脚踩在冰凉的石板上，从怀里掏出那只被防水斗篷裹了整整一宿的探测阵盘——屏幕边缘沾了几星从暗渠管壁上蹭下来的淤泥，但屏幕本身完好无损，那条紫色曲线还定格在他最后一次记录的峰值上。
云杳杳没有急着问。她把石桌上的灵米粥又往前推了半寸，用筷子头轻轻敲了敲碗边，意思是先把粥喝完再说。然后她从储物袋里抽出一条干净的白棉布，在石桌旁边的灵泉水龙头下浸湿拧干，递给赵烈让他把脸上的淤泥擦一擦。赵烈接过来的时候白棉布上立刻印出一大片灰黑色的泥渍，他这才意识到自己脸上糊了多厚一层泥壳。
林青璇把剩下的半碗粥搁在桌上，用手背抹了一下嘴角，把赵烈那叠草纸接过来，一张一张摊开铺在石桌上，从沼泽外围的安全路线图一直铺到塔底地下二层的结构平面图。草纸上被沼泽潮气洇得有些发皱，有几张边角被泥水泡软了，炭条写的字迹也晕开了几分，但赵烈的笔迹一向工整，该标注的数字、时间、方位一个都没少。她把草纸铺好后，把最上面那张——画着塔底茧子敲击信号节奏图的——单独抽出来，放在云杳杳面前。
“万毒窟的情况比我们之前预想的复杂得多。”林青璇的嗓音还带着刚从瘴气里钻出来的沙哑，但语气沉静得像是她在背一份早已整理好的卷宗。她伸手指向草纸上那片用炭条勾出来的沼泽轮廓，“黑水沼泽外围的蛇涎滩、瘴气林、淤泥湾三处天然屏障已经被蛊虫利用到了极致。蛇涎滩的淤泥深度足够把一头成年犀角兽活活陷进去，唯一的硬泥路线被沈月标注在一棵雷击榕树的正南侧，标记是三道斜杠。那棵榕树还在，树根部的硬泥上还有她刻刀留下的痕迹，已经被新长出来的青苔盖了大半，但斜杠的凹槽摸得出来。”
“瘴气林里的蛊虫不是散养的。”赵烈把脚擦干净后重新套上一双干燥的布袜，一边系靴带一边补充，“我们在林子里一棵榕树干上发现了五条极细极直的爪痕，深到树芯，每一道痕之间的距离分毫不差，是蛊虫用同一种角度、同一种力道反复抓出来的。爪痕旁边地面上有一片被压扁的腐叶——是人蜷缩躺过的痕迹，边缘溅了几滴蛊虫体液，已经开始氧化发暗。而且——”他顿了顿，看了一眼林青璇，林青璇点了点头，他才继续说下去，“而且在那个睡痕旁边，还有一串朝万毒窟方向延伸的脚印。步幅极大，在十丈外直接消失。那人是飞走的。能在瘴气林里飞行的，修为至少金仙境以上。”
“所以瘴气林不只是天然屏障，也是混沌神殿用来关押俘虏的露天牢房。被抓住的修士先被丢在瘴气林里，让瘴气和蛊虫双重折磨，等灵力耗尽后被飞进去的敌人带走——要么送进塔里做剥离手术，要么直接丢进血池给母核做养料。”林青璇的指尖在草纸上圈出了一个粗略的范围，“我们沿沈月的路线横穿瘴气林，一共发现三处类似的睡痕，都在榕树根部。榕树根部的腐叶层最厚，人在上面蜷一晚勉强能保一点体温。这些痕迹分布在外围区域，说明被抓的人被丢在瘴气林外围，还没有来得及被运进塔里，或者——”她顿了顿，“或者敌人故意把他们留在外围，用来引诱更多人进入瘴气林搜索。”
云杳杳听完这一段，把一只脚踩在石凳边上，膝盖弯起来顶着手肘，身子微微向前倾。她的眼睛没有看那些草纸，而是看着林青璇左肋下被碎石划出来的那道白痕——灵犀皮甲表面刮出了一道浅而长的白印子，皮甲的纤维层没有断裂，但白痕周围有一圈极细的裂纹。她伸出手指在那道白痕上轻轻点了一下，林青璇嘶了一声往后一缩，云杳杳把手收回来，脸上的表情没有太大变化，但搁在石桌上的手背绷紧了一瞬。
“涵洞的事。”她说。
林青璇端起碗把剩下的粥一口喝完，用袖子擦了擦嘴角的米汤，把地下二层通道那张草纸拖到最上面来。“万毒窟九层塔，地上五层是石砌塔身，塔檐挂满蛊虫结成的虫茧串。地下四层埋在沼泽淤泥里。塔的北侧有个废弃排水涵洞，是沈月当年逃出来时走的路线。涵洞口被蛊菌封了，菌丝网下面嵌着共鸣蛊——我用了椿禾剂外用膏涂在共鸣蛊腹部，让它们暂时休眠。涵洞里面是一条窄道，直通地下二层的运输通道。地下二层是储物层和废液回收区，堆满了空的绝灵罐和报废的蛊虫培养槽。通道尽头有一条垂直通风井，铁栅封死上楼层的口，往下是螺旋铁梯，直通第九层祭坛。”
她从怀里取出那块感字诀玉简搁在桌上，“我激活了感字诀，在通风井边缘往下探。井底深处有暗紫色光芒在闪，节奏比塔外探测到的更快更急。从井底翻上来的风是温热的，带着一股甜腥味——不是腐臭味，更接近于新翻开的土壤被雨水打湿后蒸出来的那种土腥味，但比土腥味更腻。我用感字诀半激活状态捕捉到了茧子的敲击信号。”
她的指尖点在草纸上那张节奏图上。“敲三下停一息，再敲三下再停一息，循环不断。沈月当年说茧子在叫她的名字，但我站在通风井边缘听了将近半盏茶的时间，反复比对广场上传来的蛊虫步足声——这个敲击节奏和蛊虫编队移动的步频完全同步。每一敲就是一个编队移动指令，每一停就是一个指令结束。茧子不是无意义的发声，它在用灵力脉冲指挥广场上那上千只蛊虫的协同行动。”
赵烈把探测阵盘推到云杳杳面前，指着屏幕上那条紫色曲线。“昨天傍晚林师姐激活镜字诀的时候，塔底能量波动从那个时刻开始持续攀升。暴雨只是加速了攀升的过程，但真正的触发节点是镜字诀——茧子感应到了镜面，然后提前释放了这一批新蛊虫来加强防御。早上卯时三刻，日光照到塔身飞檐上的虫茧串时，开始大规模孵化。我数到三百七十二只的时候还在出，塔身上至少还有几十个茧串没孵完。全部孵化完之后，广场上的蛊虫总数突破一千只。”
“新蛊虫刚孵出来的时候不会分辨符文纹路，有几只踩进紫色光芒里被烫得弹起来翻了个跟头，爬起来后缩在纹路边不敢靠近。老蛊虫在暴雨中被打乱了巡逻队形，花了大概半个时辰重新编组，然后把新蛊虫编入了巡逻队和固定岗。从整体上看，孵化高峰期广场上确实一度非常混乱——新蛊虫到处乱窜，老蛊虫在调整编队，蛊虫之间的通信触须碰来碰去。但这种混乱持续的时间很短，不到一个时辰老蛊虫就把所有新蛊虫归队了。”赵烈翻到草纸背面，上面画着一个粗略的时间轴，“这个混乱的空窗期是我们最好的潜入时机——如果要在日出时发动突袭，必须抢在孵化高峰期结束后、新蛊虫归队之前的那段窗口动手。窗口大约只有一炷香多一刻的时间。”
林青璇点点头，接着说回程的路线。“广场蛊虫密度在孵化高峰期过后达到顶峰，我们没法按原路翻毒瘴墙回去。用了沈月标注的备用路线——毒瘴墙南侧一段废弃排水暗渠。暗渠从墙根底下的沼泽淤泥层穿过，出口在墙外一片芦苇荡深处。管壁是陶制的，内部空间极其狭窄，只能弯腰往前挪，管道中间有树根扎穿，树根上挂着几只被沼气熏晕的小蛊虫，我用剑尖把挡路的根须割断了，没惊动它们。暗渠里全是几十年的沼气沉积物，淤泥最深到脚踝，管壁滑得手都抓不住——赵烈的探测阵盘全程举高过头顶，那个姿势保持了将近半个时辰。”
赵烈揉了揉自己还发酸的手臂，苦笑了一声。
林青璇把她和赵烈在暗渠出口观察到的情况也一并说了出来。“暗渠出口在毒瘴墙外侧一片黑水莲底下，管口被莲叶遮得严严实实。我们在管口边缘观察了百息，确认墙外没有蛊虫巡逻，才从暗渠里出来。回程绕过了淤泥湾和蛇涎滩，走了一个更靠外围的路线。到了望泽镇废弃竹棚做装备清点时，蛊虫驱避粉还剩一袋，瘴气中和散全部用完，椿禾剂外用膏用了一半，探测阵盘完整，传送玉简还在。”
她把这些话说完后，把赵烈画的那张地下二层通道结构图单独推到云杳杳面前，指着图上标注的几个关键点。“通道两侧的凹室里堆满了空的绝灵罐，罐底有编号，初步估算不下五百只。如果每只绝灵罐都曾经装过一根灵根，那这个塔里至少剥离了五百名修士的灵根。这个数字还不包括被直接丢进血池做养料的。混沌神殿在万毒窟的规模，比东域城、苍梧山、焚风谷加起来还要大。万毒窟不是普通的采集据点——它很可能就是混沌神殿在东华仙界的总站。”
云杳杳把这些草纸从头到尾看了一遍，然后拿起了最上面那张节奏图，看着上面赵烈用炭条画的三个点加一个横杠的重复标记。她把这张纸放在石桌上，指尖在那三下敲击的标记上轻轻点了三下，节奏与林青璇描述的完全一致。
她沉默了一会儿，然后说了一句让林青璇差点把手里粥碗扣在桌上的话。
“茧子在敲给谁听。”

林青璇愣住了。她张了张嘴，想说什么，但又闭上了。赵烈的炭条从手指间滑下来，在石板上弹了一下，滚到石桌底下去了。
“敲三下停一息——这个节奏是召唤指令，没错。”云杳杳的指尖还搁在草纸上那三个点上，语气很淡，像是在自言自语，“但它敲给谁听的？广场上的蛊虫不需要这么复杂的信号也能被灵力脉冲直接驱动。你在涵洞口听蛊虫步足声和敲击完全同步，说明广场上的蛊虫确实在按这个节奏移动——但它们是被灵力脉冲推着走的，还是被敲击信号叫过去的？如果是灵力脉冲直接驱动，那敲击只是一个附带现象，不需要任何接收者。但如果这个敲击真的是在‘召唤’什么东西，那广场上的蛊虫只是被灵力脉冲顺便推着走，真正的接收者——不是你听到的那上千只蛊虫。”
她把指尖从草纸上收回来，指了指地下二层结构图上的垂直通风井。“你站在通风井边缘往下听的时候，你说那股腥风是从井底翻上来的，温热的。沈月当年说茧子叫她的名字，她听到的是‘沈月’两个字。你听到的是敲击节奏。你们两个听到的声音不一样——但都是真实存在的。茧子既能发出音节语言，也能发出敲击信号。它的灵力脉冲同时驱动了广场上千只蛊虫的编队，你听到的是这个。但敲击信号还在往外发送，你在暗渠里听不到，你在毒瘴墙外听不到——这个敲击信号的接收者，不在塔里，也不在广场上。”
林青璇缓缓放下粥碗，手指无意识地攥紧了碗沿。
“你的意思是——茧子在往外发信号？在召唤外面的人——或者说，外面的东西？”
云杳杳没有直接回答。她把赵烈探测阵盘上的紫色曲线仔细看了一遍，把阵盘屏幕从记录模式切到实时监控模式——虽然现在已经离开了万毒窟的范围，阵盘接不到塔底的地脉信号，但那些已经存储的波形数据还在。她把曲线从昨天傍晚到今天凌晨的时间段逐段回放，在镜字诀激活的时刻停下，然后又把时间轴往后拖到暴雨开始的时间，再拖到卯时日出孵化开始的时间。三条不同时间段的能量波动曲线并排显示在屏幕上，形状各不相同，但都有一个共同的底层特征——在每一个能量峰值之间，都存在一组极规律的低频脉冲，频率与林青璇描述的敲击节奏完全吻合。
“你看这一组低频脉冲。它在镜字诀激活之前就已经存在了——振幅很低，几乎被地脉的杂波盖过去，但频率稳得不像自然现象。镜字诀激活之后振幅开始上升，暴雨之后又翻了一倍，孵化高峰期达到峰值。”云杳杳用手指在屏幕上画了一条线，“这个敲击信号不是昨晚才开始的。它一直在敲，只是之前敲得轻，你的探测阵盘灵敏度不够，录不到。直到镜字诀惊动了茧子，茧子开始敲得更大声，阵盘才捕捉到了清晰的波形。”
赵烈把炭条从桌底下捡回来，又拿了一张新草纸铺好，飞快地记着云杳杳的话。写到一半他停了一下，抬起头问：“那接收者在哪里？如果茧子的敲击信号一直都存在，只是之前敲得轻——那它一直在敲给同一个接收者。接收者在黑水沼泽外面？”
“不一定在黑水沼泽外面。”云杳杳把阵盘屏幕关掉，放回石桌上，脚从石凳上放下来，站直了身子。晨光已经穿过忘忧峰后山的云雾，照在石榴树的叶片上，把叶脉照得透亮透亮的。她伸手摘了一片石榴叶在手里转了两圈，然后把它放在石桌上那张地下二层结构图的正中央——正好盖住了垂直通风井的位置。
“茧子在塔底第九层，垂直通风井下。敲击信号通过地脉和灵力脉冲往外发。广场上的蛊虫只是被灵力脉冲顺带推动的——它们不是接收者，它们是信号传输过程中附带被搅动的。真正的接收者不在塔里。但也不一定在黑水沼泽外面。”
她把那片石榴叶从结构图上拿开，然后用手沾了点茶水，在石桌上画了一个更大的圈，把整个结构图都圈了进去。“茧子的敲击信号频率太低，穿透不了太远的空间距离——塔底第九层到毒瘴墙外是直线距离近千丈，中间还有沼泽淤泥层衰减，信号会很快衰减到无法被识别。但在地下的传播效率比空中高得多。沼泽淤泥里全是水，水的声传导效率是空气的四倍多。敲击信号不是通过空气传出去的，是通过沼泽地下的地下水传出去的。接收者——在水里。”
林青璇脑子里像是有个罩子被人从里面猛地掀开了。
“暗河。塔底祭坛下面有条暗河——沈月说过，她当年被关在第九层时，听见祭坛底下有水流声。万毒窟整个塔都建在沼泽里，沼泽地下肯定有水系。茧子的敲击信号沿着暗河的水流往外传，可以传得很远很远——比在空气中传得远得多，也比地脉灵能脉冲传得更稳定。”
“如果敲击信号是通过水传出去的，那它的接收者肯定也在水里。或者——至少在水系覆盖的范围内。”赵烈翻开沈月当年画的万毒窟水系分布图，飞快地扫了一遍，“黑水沼泽的地下水系很发达，大大小小有几十条暗河，万毒窟塔底那条是其中最大的一条干流，支流延伸到整个沼泽区域，甚至延伸到沼泽外围的旱地。如果把接收者定位在水系覆盖的范围内——”他的手指在水系图上循着那条最大暗河的流向往东南方向移动，越过沼泽边界，停在一片标注着“无资料”的空白区域，“暗河从这个方向流出沼泽。再往东南是什么地方，沈月的地图上没有标记。”
“暗河下游。茧子的召唤信号是沿着暗河往下游发的。”云杳杳把石桌上的草纸一张一张收起来，按观察记录、结构图、节奏图、水系图的顺序叠好，用一块镇纸压住，“万毒窟这个据点不是孤立的。塔底茧子在召唤下游某个存在。可能是另一个巨茧，可能是一个更成熟的母体，也可能是比母核更高一级的东西——能够接收召唤信号的东西。如果下游那个存在已经被召唤信号叫醒了，并且在往上游移动，那攻打万毒窟就不是摧毁一个孤立据点的问题，而是要同时面对两个甚至更多个成熟母体。”
content_en:
Before Lin Qingxuan could swallow the mouthful of porridge in her mouth, Zhao Lie's boots had already left two wet mud footprints on the stone slab of Wangyou Peak. He collapsed on the stone bench and let out a long breath as his back rested against the rough trunk of the pomegranate tree, as if he had let out all the miasma and tension that had been held in his chest all night. The boots soaked in the swamp mud made a squelching sound every time they moved. The socks and insoles were soaked up by the muddy water of the blackwater swamp, and they slipped on the stone slabs. He simply took off his boots and put them under the stone bench, stepped on the cold stone slab with his bare feet, and took out the detection array disk that had been wrapped in a waterproof cloak all night from his arms. The edge of the screen was stained with a few specks of mud scraped from the wall of the culvert, but the screen itself was intact, and the purple curve was still fixed at the peak value he recorded last time.
Yun Yaoyao didn't ask in a hurry. She pushed the spirit rice porridge on the stone table forward another half inch and tapped the edge of the bowl with the tip of her chopsticks, meaning to finish the porridge first. Then she pulled out a piece of clean white cotton cloth from the storage bag, soaked it under the Lingquan faucet next to the stone table and wrung it out, and handed it to Zhao Lie to wipe the mud off his face. When Zhao Lie took it, a large gray-black mud stain immediately appeared on the white cotton cloth. Only then did he realize how thick a layer of mud was on his face.
Lin Qingxuan put the remaining half bowl of porridge on the table, wiped the corners of her mouth with the back of her hand, took the stack of straw paper from Zhao Lie, and spread it out one by one on the stone table, from the safety route map outside the swamp to the structural plan of the second underground floor of the tower. The papyrus paper was a little wrinkled by the swamp moisture, and some of the corners were softened by mud and water. The writing on the charcoal strips was also a little blurred, but Zhao Lie's handwriting was always neat, and there were no missing numbers, times, or directions that should be marked. After laying out the straw paper, she took out the top one - the one with the rhythm diagram of the cocoon tapping signal at the bottom of the tower - and placed it in front of Yun Yaoyao.
"The situation in Ten Thousand Poison Cave is much more complicated than we previously expected." Lin Qingxuan's voice was still hoarse as she had just emerged from the miasma, but her tone was as calm as if she was memorizing a file that had already been compiled. She pointed at the outline of the swamp drawn with charcoal strips on the paper, "The three natural barriers on the outskirts of the blackwater swamp, the Snake Beach, the Miasma Forest, and the Silt Bay, have been exploited to the extreme by Gu insects. The mud in the Snake Beach is deep enough to trap an adult rhino-horned beast alive. The only hard mud route was marked by Shen Yue on the south side of a lightning-struck banyan tree, marked by three slashes. The banyan tree is still there, and the hard mud at the base of the tree still has the marks left by her carving knife. It has been mostly covered by the newly grown moss, but the grooves of the slashes can be felt. "
"The voodoo insects in the miasma forest do not live freely." Zhao Lie wiped his feet clean and put on a pair of dry cloth socks again, while tying his bootlaces and added, "We found five extremely thin and straight claw marks on the trunk of a banyan tree in the forest, which were as deep as the core of the tree. The distance between each mark was exactly the same. The voodoo insects used the same angle and the same force to grab it repeatedly. There was a flattened rotten leaf on the ground next to the claw marks - it was The traces of where the person had been lying curled up had begun to oxidize and darken. And -" He paused and glanced at Lin Qingxuan, who nodded before continuing, "Besides the sleeping mark, there was a series of footprints extending towards the Ten Thousand Poison Cave. The person flew away. He must be at least above the Golden Immortal Realm to be able to fly in the miasma forest."
"So the miasma forest is not only a natural barrier, but also an open-air cell used by the Chaos Temple to hold captives. The captured monks are first thrown into the miasma forest to be tortured by the miasma and the poisonous insects. After their spiritual power is exhausted, they are taken away by the enemies flying in - either sent to the tower for stripping surgery, or directly thrown into the blood pool to nourish the mother core." Lin QingXuan's fingertips circled a rough area on the paper, "We followed Shen Yue's route across the miasma forest and found a total of three similar sleep marks, all at the roots of the banyan tree. The root of the banyan tree has the thickest layer of rotten leaves, and a person can barely maintain a little body temperature by curling up there for a night. These traces are distributed in the outer area, indicating that the captured people were left outside the Miasma Forest before they could be transported into the tower, or -" she paused, "or the enemy deliberately left them outside to lure more people into the Miasma Forest to search."
After Yun Yaoyao listened to this paragraph, he stepped on the edge of the stone bench with one foot, bent his knees to support his elbows, and leaned forward slightly. Her eyes did not look at the straw paper, but at the white mark scratched by the gravel under Lin Qingxuan's left rib - a shallow and long white mark scratched on the surface of the Lingxi leather armor. The fiber layer of the leather armor was not broken, but there was a circle of very fine cracks around the white mark. She stretched out her finger and tapped the white mark lightly. Lin Qingxuan hissed and shrank back. Yun Yaoyao retracted her hand. The expression on her face did not change much, but the back of her hand resting on the stone table tensed for a moment.
"About the culvert," she said.
Lin Qingxuan picked up the bowl and drank the rest of the porridge in one gulp, wiped the rice soup at the corner of her mouth with her sleeve, and dragged the piece of straw paper in the second-floor underground passage to the top. "The nine-story tower of Ten Thousand Poison Cave, the five floors above ground are made of stone, and the tower eaves are covered with strings of cocoons made by voodoo insects. The four underground floors are buried in the swamp mud. There is an abandoned drainage culvert on the north side of the tower, which was the route Shen Yue took when she escaped. The entrance of the culvert was sealed by the voodoo fungus, and the resonance voodoo was embedded under the mycelium net - I used Chunhejie topical ointment to apply on the resonance voodoo. Inside the culvert is a narrow passage that leads directly to the transportation passage on the second underground floor. The second underground floor is filled with empty magic tanks and scrapped Gu insect cultivation tanks. There is a vertical ventilation shaft at the end of the passage, with an iron grille sealing the entrance to the upper floor, and a spiral iron ladder leading down to the altar on the ninth floor.
She took out the jade slip of Senzi Jue from her arms and placed it on the table. "I activated Senzi Jue and probed down at the edge of the ventilation shaft. There was a dark purple light flashing deep in the bottom of the well, and the rhythm was faster and more urgent than that detected outside the tower. The wind rising from the bottom of the well was warm. It's hot, with a sweet smell - not a rotten smell, but closer to the earthy smell that evaporates from newly opened soil after being wetted by rain, but more greasy than the earthy smell. I caught the cocoon's tapping signal with the semi-activated state of Sensing Zijue."
Her fingertips clicked on the rhythm chart on the papyrus paper. "Knock three times, pause, then knock three more times, pause again, and the cycle continues. Shen Yue said back then that Cocoon was calling her name, but I stood on the edge of the ventilation shaft and listened for nearly half a cup of tea, repeatedly comparing it to the sound of Gu insects' footsteps coming from the square - this tapping rhythm The rhythm of the movement of the Gu worm formation is completely synchronized. Each stroke is a formation movement command, and each stop is the end of a command. It is not making meaningless sounds, it is directing the coordinated actions of the thousands of Gu worms in the square. "
Zhao Lie pushed the detection array disk in front of Yun Yaoyao and pointed at the purple curve on the screen. "When Senior Sister Lin activated the Mirror Technique last evening, the energy fluctuations at the bottom of the tower continued to rise from that moment on. The heavy rain only accelerated the climbing process, but the real triggering node was the Mirror Zi Technique - Cocoon sensed the mirror surface, and then released this batch of new Gu insects in advance to strengthen it. Defense. When the sunlight hit the cocoon strings on the tower's eaves, they began to hatch on a large scale. When I counted three hundred and seventy-two, there were still at least dozens of cocoon strings left to hatch, and the total number of Gu insects in the square exceeded one thousand."
"When the new Gu worms were just hatched, they couldn't distinguish the rune patterns. Some of them stepped into the purple light and were so hot that they bounced and turned somersaults. After getting up, they huddled beside the lines and didn't dare to get close. The old Gu worms are here.The patrol formation was disrupted during the heavy rain, and it took about half an hour to regroup, and then the new Gu insects were incorporated into the patrol team and fixed posts. On the whole, the square was indeed very chaotic during the peak period of hatching - new Gu bugs were running around, old Gu bugs were adjusting their formations, and the communication tentacles between the Gu bugs were touching each other. But this chaos lasted only a short time. In less than an hour, the old Gu worms had all the new Gu worms returned to their ranks. "Zhao Lie turned to the back of the papyrus, and a rough timeline was drawn on it, "This chaotic window period is our best opportunity to sneak in - if we want to launch a surprise attack at sunrise, we must seize the window after the peak incubation period is over and before the new Gu insects return to the team. The window is only about a moment longer than a stick of incense. "
Lin Qingxuan nodded and continued to talk about the return route. “The density of Gu insects in the square reaches its peak after the peak incubation period, and we cannot go back through the poison miasma wall in the same way. He used the alternate route marked by Shen Yue - a section of abandoned drainage culvert on the south side of the Poisonous Miasma Wall. The culvert passes through the swamp silt layer under the wall, and its outlet is deep in a reed marsh outside the wall. The wall of the pipe is made of pottery, and the internal space is extremely narrow. I can only bend down and move forward. There are tree roots piercing the middle of the pipe. There are several small bugs that were stunned by the methane hanging on the tree roots. I used the tip of my sword to cut off the roots blocking the road without disturbing them. The culvert was filled with decades of methane deposits. The silt was as deep as the ankles, and the pipe wall was so slippery that it was difficult to hold on to it. Zhao Lie's detection array was raised above his head the entire time, and he maintained that position for nearly half an hour. "
Zhao Lie rubbed his sore arms and smiled bitterly.
Lin Qingxuan also told what she and Zhao Lie observed at the exit of the culvert. "The outlet of the culvert is under a patch of black water lilies on the outside of the poisonous miasma wall, and the mouth of the pipe is completely covered by lotus leaves. We observed Baixi at the edge of the pipe mouth to confirm that there were no Gu insects patrolling outside the wall, and then came out of the culvert. On the return trip, we bypassed Silt Bay and Shesalitan and took a more peripheral route. When we went to the abandoned bamboo shed in Wangze Town to do an equipment inventory, we found that there was still one bag of poison repellent powder, all the miasma neutralizing powder was used, half of the Chunheji external ointment was used, the detection array disk was intact, and the teleportation jade slip was still there. "
After she finished saying these words, she pushed the structural diagram of the second-floor underground passage drawn by Zhao Lie in front of Yun Yaoyao alone, and pointed at several key points marked on the diagram. "The alcoves on both sides of the passage are filled with empty Jueling jars. There are numbers on the bottom of the jars. It is initially estimated that there are no less than five hundred. If every soul jar once contained a spiritual root, then the spiritual roots of at least five hundred monks had been stripped away from this tower. This number does not include those who were directly thrown into the blood pool for nourishment. The scale of the Chaos Temple in Ten Thousand Poison Cave is larger than that of Dongyu City, Cangwu Mountain, and Fenfeng Valley combined. Ten Thousand Poison Cave is not an ordinary collection base - it is probably the headquarters of the Chaos Temple in the Donghua Immortal Realm. "
Yun Yaoyao read these papyri from beginning to end, then picked up the top rhythm diagram and looked at the repeated marks of three dots plus a horizontal bar drawn by Zhao Lie with charcoal strips. She placed the paper on the stone table and tapped her fingertips three times on the three tap marks. The rhythm was exactly the same as Lin Qingxuan's description.
She was silent for a while, and then said something that made Lin Qingxuan almost slam her porridge bowl on the table.
"Who is Cocoon talking to? "
Lin Qingxuan was stunned. She opened her mouth to say something, but closed it again. Zhao Lie's charcoal stick slipped from his fingers, bounced on the stone floor, and rolled to the bottom of the stone table.
"Strike three times and pause for one breath - this rhythm is a summons command, yes. "Yun Yaoyao's fingertips were still resting on the three points on the papyrus paper, and his tone was very calm, as if he was talking to himself, "But who is it meant for? The Gu insects in the square can be directly driven by spiritual pulses without such complicated signals. If you listen to the footsteps and tapping of the bugs at the entrance of the culvert, they are completely synchronized, which means that the bugs in the square are indeed tapping.This rhythm moves—but are they pushed along by pulses of psychic energy, or are they called over by a tapping signal? If it is directly driven by spiritual pulses, the knocking is just an epiphenomenon and does not require any receiver. But if this knocking is really 'summoning' something, then the Gu insects in the square are just pushed away by the spiritual pulse, and the real recipients are not the thousands of Gu insects you heard. "
She retracted her fingertips from the straw paper and pointed at the vertical ventilation shaft on the structural diagram of the second underground floor. "When you stood on the edge of the ventilation shaft and listened, you said that the fishy wind came up from the bottom of the well and was warm. Shen Yue said that when Yuzi called her name, she heard the word 'Shen Yue'. What you hear is a percussive rhythm. The sounds you two hear are different—but both are real. The cocoon can produce both syllabic speech and percussive signals. Its spiritual pulse simultaneously drives a formation of thousands of Gu insects in the square. This is what you heard. But the knocking signal is still being sent out. You can't hear it in the culvert, you can't hear it outside the miasma wall - the recipient of this knocking signal is not in the tower, nor in the square. "
Lin Qingxuan slowly put down the porridge bowl, and unconsciously clenched the edge of the bowl with her fingers.
"You mean - the cocoon is sending signals? Calling someone outside—or rather, something outside? "
Yun Yaoyao did not answer directly. She carefully read the purple curve on Zhao Lie's detection array disk, and switched the array disk screen from the recording mode to the real-time monitoring mode - although she had now left the range of the Ten Thousand Poison Cave, and the array disk could not receive the ground pulse signal from the bottom of the tower, the stored waveform data was still there. She replayed the curve piece by piece from yesterday evening to early this morning, stopping at the moment when the Mirror Technique was activated, and then dragged the timeline back to the time when the rainstorm started, and then to the time when the sunrise and hatching began at Mao hour. Three energy fluctuation curves of different time periods are displayed side by side on the screen. The shapes are different, but they all have a common underlying feature - between each energy peak, there is a set of extremely regular low-frequency pulses, and the frequency is completely consistent with the percussion rhythm described by Lin Qingxuan.
"Look at this set of low-frequency pulses. It existed before the activation of Mirror Zi Jue - the amplitude was very low, almost covered by the clutter of the earth's veins, but the frequency was so stable that it didn't look like a natural phenomenon. The amplitude began to rise after the activation of Mirror Zi Jue, doubled again after the heavy rain, and reached its peak during the peak hatching period. "Yun Yaoyao drew a line on the screen with his finger, "This tapping signal didn't just start last night. It keeps knocking, but it was knocked softly before. Your detection array disk is not sensitive enough and cannot record. It wasn't until the Mirror Zijue alerted Cocoon and Cocoon started knocking louder that the formation disk captured a clear waveform. "
Zhao Lie picked up the charcoal strips from under the table, took a new piece of straw paper and laid it out, and quickly memorized Yun Yaoyao's words. He paused in the middle of writing, raised his head and asked: "Where is the recipient? If the cocoon's knock signal has always been there, but it was knocked softly before - then it keeps knocking to the same recipient. Receiver outside Blackwater Swamp? "
“Not necessarily outside Blackwater Marsh. "Yun Yaoyao turned off the array screen and put it back on the stone table. She put her feet down from the stone bench and stood up straight. The morning light had passed through the clouds and mist on the mountain behind Wangyou Peak and shone on the leaves of the pomegranate tree, illuminating the veins of the leaves. She reached out and picked a pomegranate leaf, turned it twice in her hand, and then placed it in the center of the second underground floor structure diagram on the stone table - just covering the position of the vertical ventilation shaft.
"The cocoon is on the ninth floor of the tower, under the vertical ventilation shaft. The tapping signal is sent out through ley lines and spiritual pulses. The Gu insects in the square were only incidentally pushed by the spiritual pulse - they were not recipients, they were incidentally stirred during the signal transmission process. The real recipient is not in the towerinside. But not necessarily outside Blackwater Swamp. "
She took the pomegranate leaf away from the structure diagram, then dipped her hand in some tea, and drew a larger circle on the stone table, encompassing the entire structure diagram. “The frequency of the cocoon’s knocking signal is too low and cannot penetrate too far in space—the straight-line distance from the ninth floor of the tower to the outside of the miasma wall is nearly a thousand feet, and there is attenuation in the swamp sludge layer in between. The signal will quickly attenuate to the point where it cannot be identified. But the propagation efficiency is much higher underground than in the air. The swamp mud is full of water, and the sound transmission efficiency of water is more than four times that of air. The knocking signal is not transmitted through the air, but through the groundwater beneath the swamp. Receiver - in the water. "
Lin Qingxuan's mind felt like a cover was suddenly lifted from the inside.
“Underwater river. There is an underground river under the altar at the bottom of the tower - Shen Yue said that when she was imprisoned on the ninth floor, she heard the sound of water flowing under the altar. The entire tower of Ten Thousand Poison Cave is built in a swamp, and there must be a water system underground in the swamp. The cocoon's knocking signal is transmitted along the water of the underground river, and can be transmitted very far - much further than in the air, and more stable than the pulse of leyline energy. "
"If the knock signal was transmitted through water, then its recipient must also be in the water. Or - at least within the area covered by the water system. "Zhao Lie opened the water system distribution map of Ten Thousand Poison Cave that Shen Yue had drawn back then and scanned it quickly. "The underground water system of Blackwater Swamp is very developed. There are dozens of underground rivers, large and small. The one at the bottom of Ten Thousand Poison Cave Tower is the largest main stream among them. The tributaries extend to the entire swamp area and even to the dry land outside the swamp. If the receiver is positioned within the coverage of the river system -" His finger followed the flow of the largest underground river on the water system map in the southeast direction, crossed the swamp boundary, and stopped at a blank area marked "No data", "the underground river flows out of the swamp from this direction. Somewhere further to the southeast was not marked on Shen Yue's map. "
“The lower reaches of the Dark River. Cocoon's summoning signal was sent downstream along the underground river. "Yun Yaoyao collected the straw paper on the stone table one by one, stacked them in the order of observation records, structural diagrams, rhythm diagrams, and water system diagrams, and pressed them down with a paperweight, "The stronghold of Ten Thousand Poison Cave is not isolated. The cocoon at the bottom of the tower is summoning someone downstream. It may be another giant cocoon, it may be a more mature mother body, or it may be something higher than the mother core - something that can receive the summoning signal. If the being downstream has been awakened by the summoning signal and is moving upstream, then attacking the Ten Thousand Poison Cave is not a matter of destroying an isolated stronghold, but of facing two or more mature mothers at the same time. "
